propositions: Add a new advisory, AGENT-tier CONTAINER plan-review criterion `decomp-shape` (facet container, like G3/G4, not codebase-grounding) that audits parent/children decomposition shape.

The criterion detects two decomposition smells: layer-cake splits (children partitioned by architectural layer) and consumed-artifact-without-ordering-edge (a child consumes a sibling's output with no depends_on/blocks edge).

Register the criterion in CANONICAL_LLM and AGENT_TIER with a routing entry, rubric prompt, and regenerated guide section so validate_packaged_routing and validate_criteria_guide pass and it fans out through pass1_container.
Extend eval_solver's container arm to run container criteria via pass1_container over a children: fixture, keeping the bounded sanity run to one live container call per fixture.

The criterion ships permanently advisory (never blocks); blocking promotion is double-gated on dogfood effectiveness plus E6 judge order-stability clearing floor (fleiss_kappa 0.55 < 0.6 currently fails).
Bounded sanity with four hand-authored fixtures achieved recall 1.0 over both positives and false-accept 0.0 over both negatives; change landed on main via Gerrit.
